Definition: iron (as cutting); by extension, an iron implement
BiblicalUsage: 1) iron; 1a) iron; 1a1) iron ore; 1a2) as material of furniture, utensils, implements; 2) tool of iron; 3) harshness, strength, oppression (fig.)
